stem: Which benefit is appropriately associated with membership in a professional nursing organization such as ANA?

options.A: Access to continuing education, mentoring/networking opportunities, and advocacy resources
options.B: Automatic authority to practice outside state scope-of-practice laws
options.C: Guaranteed specialty certification without meeting credential requirements

rationale: ANA membership materials identify continuing education, professional networking/mentoring, and advocacy resources among member benefits. Membership does not replace legal scope, credentialing, or competency requirements.
educational_objective: Identify realistic professional-development benefits of nursing-organization membership.
source_locator: Membership benefits — continuing education, networking/mentoring, professional and advocacy resources
source_claim_supported: Professional nursing organization membership can provide continuing education, networking/mentoring, and advocacy resources.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Management of Care, printed p.7/PDF p.11
correction_summary: Removed unsupported claims about universal certification pathways and retained benefits explicitly listed by ANA.
